Comprehensive Blood Analytics

A deeper look with 80+ Blood Biomarkers

Pairing state-of-the-art MRI anatomical imaging with clinical laboratory blood panels gives you the total health baseline.

16 Markers

Cardiovascular & Lipids

ApoB, LDL-P, hs-CRP, and advanced lipid particle metrics for early heart disease stratification.

12 Markers

Metabolic & Insulin Health

Fasting insulin, HbA1c, HOMA-IR, and glucose dynamics detecting pre-diabetes years early.

22 Markers

Hormonal & Longevity Panels

Thyroid panel (TSH, Free T3/T4), testosterone, DHEA-S, and IGF-1 for energy and vitality optimization.

18 Markers

Liver, Kidney & Electrolytes

eGFR, ALT/AST, Cystatin C, BUN, and microalbumin identifying hidden organ stress.

14 Markers

Inflammation & Immune Status

hs-CRP, Homocysteine, ESR, and complete blood count with differential.

10 Markers

Cellular Health & Nutrients

Vitamin D, Ferritin, B12, Magnesium RBC, and intracellular micronutrient baselines.

The Proactive Protocol

Scan. Review. Track. Repeat.

01

Scan in Comfort

Relax in our state-of-the-art scanner while watching Netflix or listening to Spotify. 60 minutes, zero radiation, zero contrast dye injections.

02

Physician Review

Expert dual-read evaluation by fellowship-trained radiologists. Receive your interactive 3D web & mobile report within days.

03

Track Health Baseline

Understand your organ volumetrics, visceral fat %, spine health, and blood biomarkers in a unified digital health dashboard.

04

Repeat & Protect

Annual check-ups establish longitudinal baselines to detect micro-deviations before they develop into chronic diseases.
